sections.title: I help experienced data professionals who already do a lead's job get their priorities agreed, their work seen and the title to match.
sections.description: If you want help with the promotion case you're writing or the stakeholder who keeps saying no, we work on it 1-on-1. I coach alongside my day job as Head of Data Engineering, and it starts with a free 30-minute discovery call where I don't pitch. Book it and tell me what you're stuck on.
sections.quote: I found very helpful one of the communication playbooks that I applied and successfully delivered at work: first the benefits of the solution, next the pain the said solution mitigated or eliminated, and only then the solution details. It builds a nice narrative and really levels up!
sections.quoteLinkText: More on the wall of love

sections.title: Free 10-day email course
sections.description: If you want your "not now" to hold and a yes from the people above you, start here. Over your first 10 days it covers how I rank requests and how I get buy-in for my most ambitious projects. After that, Data Gibberish comes twice a week. Join 5,000+ subscribers.
sections.quote: This is why I follow Yordan's posts, it comes from experience, its valuable, and its real. Because its clearly written a bit hastily by a senior engineer and not by an AI.
